retrievalProfile.description: A dramatic male portrait featuring a high-contrast red shirt against a dark, textured background with vertically stacked, condensed typography.
triggerTerms: dramatic male portrait in red shirt

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man with blonde hair wearing a vibrant red button-down shirt, positioned on the left, looking away from the camera. The right side is dominated by dark, textured negative space containing vertically stacked text in two distinct styles: a clean condensed sans-serif and a distressed, smaller serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center to the left
High contrast between the red shirt and dark background
Textual weight balanced against the visual weight of the subject
Warm directional lighting creating deep shadows
coreInvariants: Vibrant red shirt as the primary color focal point
Vertically stacked text blocks on the right third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject occupies the left 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red shirt acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down the red shirt, then across to the stacked typography on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space on the right side to accommodate text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant warm red of the shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm highlights on the subject's hair and face.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject and background; high saturation on the shirt.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to reds, blacks, and warm skin tones.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses extremely tall, narrow proportions.
Secondary text uses irregular, eroded edges and heavy texture.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between clean, tall modernism and gritty, distressed traditionalism.
graphicDevices: Text alignment to a right-side grid

avoid: Bright colors for text other than white or muted red

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extra-condensed, tall sans-serif display style.
Matches the slab-serif skeleton for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with blonde hair in a vibrant red button-down shirt, standing against a dark, textured industrial wall. Use dramatic side lighting to create deep shadows on the right side of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertically stacked text on the right side. Use a tall, white, extra-condensed sans-serif for the main name and a smaller, distressed, muted-red slab-serif for the secondary title.

verificationChecks: Is the shirt a vibrant, saturated red?
Is the text stacked vertically on the right side?
Is there a clear contrast between the clean sans-serif and the distressed serif?
Is the lighting dramatic and directional?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for the shirt
Degree of distress on the secondary font
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the background texture is generic and not a specific trademarked location

mustAchieve: Rich color saturation in the red garment

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red shirt is the most saturated element.
Verify the text is legible despite the distress on the secondary font.
Ensure the subject is looking away from the text area.
Confirm the background remains dark and moody.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait on left + Dark textured negative space on right + Stacked condensed typography = Country/Rock Album Aesthetic
